description: Na₂Ni(N₃H₇)₂ is Indium-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. The structure is zero-dimensional and consists of two Na₂Ni(N₃H₇)₂ clusters. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five N and two equivalent H atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.60 Å. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Ni is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent N atoms. All Ni-N bond lengths are 1.92 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and two H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and three H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom.
